articles.title: Receive a Charizard via Mystery Gift!
articles.snippet: Use a Mystery Gift code to be revealed during the Japan Championships (JCS) stream to redeem a Charizard in Pokémon Champions! It has the Ability Blaze and the moves Flare Blitz, Dragon Claw, Thunder…

articles.title: Stream details and caster line-up for the Japan Championships (JCS) have been announced!
articles.snippet: The tournament will be streamed by TPC on 6–7 June, in Japanese, with Motochika Nabeshima, Shohei Taguchi, Hakushu Takeuchi and Refu as casters!

articles.title: Sign-ups for the Monthly Challenge Series May 2026 are open!
articles.snippet: This online competition, featuring single battles and held on 29 May–1 June 2026, awards a Gallade, 100 Quick Coupons and trainer titles to the participants, as well as special titles to the best…

articles.title: A new wave of the Incineroar the Unrivaled 7★ Tera Raid Battle event is live!
articles.snippet: This Tera Raid Battle event lasts until 28 May. Incineroar the Unrivaled was last featured in September 2024, so take this chance to catch it if you didn't back then!

articles.title: The Play! Pokémon Rules and Resources have been updated!
articles.snippet: The most important update is the inclusion of Stat Alignments (previously called Natures) in the open team lists for all TPCi tournaments, similar to the way TPC runs OTS tournaments in Asia.
